services.name: Vida Mia Swim Package
services.desc: Charter the Historic Vida Mia for an Unforgettable Afternoon on the Water 3 hours Our most popular offering. Perfect for large groups and families. Catered lunch by Aloha Culinary Group and premium bar service included. We cruise along the beautiful Waikiki Coast and then anchor off “the bite” which is the shallow sandy area of Waikiki Beach. Snorkel Gear provided. Child and pet All-Inclusive Private Charter • 3 Hours • Starting at $4,250

services.name: Morning Coffee Cruise
services.desc: Start your Day with Coffee on a yacht. Our coffee is grown in Kona and roasted right here in Honolulu. Pastries are baked fresh daily and our fruit platters boast a beautiful selection of seasonal local fruit, grown on-island. services.name: Fresh Catch Friday Sunset Cruise
services.desc: End the week with a bang! Our Friday sunset cruise is not to be missed. Dinner and a show. Chef Sean of Aloha Culinary Group will be preparing a locally sourced dinner of fresh catch seafood and food by Kualoa Ranch. Open bar for the duration of the cruise. Live music by McNeill and Red. 1.5 Hours

services.name: Sunset Cruise with Cocktails and Pupus
services.desc: If you are looking for an intimate cocktail cruise, come join us for a sunset sail along the coastline of beautiful Waikiki. Cocktail service and light pupus are included in the cost of a ticket. 90 minites. Our sunset sail offers great views of Diamond Head as we tour the coast of Waikiki and Honolulu. We often see pods of dolphins, whales, and sea turtles. Guests are invited to tour the entire historic vessel and our knowledgeable crew is there to help pass on the storied history of the Vida Mia. Cruise the Coast on the World-Famous Vida MIa

services.name: Vida Mia Live!
services.desc: The only collaboration of its kind in the islands, the Vida Mia brings you an intimate night with Hawaii's most exciting young talent. Vida Mia Live! is a special feature offered throughout the summer. There are only 30 available seats on each cruise. The cost of seat includes a full dinner of fresh-caught seafood by Aloha Culinary Group and an open premium bar all night long. Join us for a 90 minute cruise along the coast of Waikiki, followed by an after party at the dock, giving you a chance to mix and mingle with the musicians. ​For decades people have talked about magical moments on the 1.5 Hours

services.name: Ash Scattering Ceremony
services.desc: Charter the historic Vida Mia for your memorable event. 1.5 hours Typical course is a motor to Diamond Head and back where we cruise along Waikiki. We perform a traditional maritime ceremony where guests will scatter the ashes, the captain will then circle the ashes three times and sound the horn. Any additions such as flowers, music, pupus and beverage selections will be charged in addition to the charter fee. You may select those at check Private Charter • Up to 36 people • 1.5 hours

services.name: Full Day Private Charter
services.desc: Charter the Historic Vida Mia for an entire day! 8 hours Enjoy a full day aboard the Vida Mia! Swimming, snorkeling, sunset cruising.. Our experienced captain and crew will provide you with an unforgettable experience on the Hawaiian waters. We provide full catering and bar service. There is no better way to enjoy Private Charter • 7 Hours

services.name: Two-Day Stay Aboard Package
services.desc: A multiple day stay on one of the only tropical cruisers left in the world. The Vida Mia StayAboard package is an exclusive, once-in-a-lifetime offering. Our captain and crew will chart your course, plan every meal and we even include full beverage service for the experience of a Exclusive 2-Night Stay on the Vida Mia

blurb: Open to the public for the first time in decades, the Vida Mia is a wonderful way to experience the island. Join us on our daily coffee tour or a come along on one of our speciality curated sunset dinner cruises. Our sunset dinner cruises include fantastic local food and premium cocktails, with live music on weekends. Take in beautiful views of Diamond Head and the Honolulu Coastline any time of day.
